title: Recovery Transport Charge on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Servicing systems action card — recovery transport charge, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

### The charge

The towing work on a recovery is billed to the contract from the repossession agency's invoice as one transport charge per recovery, dated the lot-intake date, that is the date of the condition report taken when the vehicle reached the storage lot for this recovery, the most recent condition report, dated on or after the repossession date. The charge is owed from that date whether or not the customer calls. No transport charge is owed while no condition report dated on or after the repossession date is on record, because the vehicle has not yet reached the lot. The delivery of a vehicle to an auction is an auction sale expense, not a transport charge.

An involuntary recovery carries one transport charge. A voluntary surrender carries no transport charge, because the customer delivers the vehicle, and none is booked.

### When it may be booked

A transport charge may be booked while the contract is assigned for repossession, repossessed, or in deficiency after the recovered vehicle was sold. Every other repossession expense can be charged only while the contract is assigned for repossession or repossessed.

| Contract status | Transport charge may be booked | Other repossession expenses may be charged |
|---|---|---|
| Assigned for repossession | yes | yes |
| Repossessed | yes | yes |
| In deficiency after the recovered vehicle was sold | yes | no |

### Booking the charge: `book_recovery_transport_6b5d55b7`

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_recovery_transport_6b5d55b7` and then calls it. It books one repossession expense of the transport kind to the contract, dated with the stated service date, and records it exactly as given; it judges no eligibility.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `preowned_contract_id` | the reference number of the pre-owned contract the charge is booked to, as returned by the pre-owned contract lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `amount` | the transport charge in US dollars | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent |
| `service_date` | the date the charge is dated with | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Effect.** On success the contract's posting history gains one transport charge for the stated amount and the contract's fees due balance rises by that amount; the customer sees the charge on the account and in any figure that includes fees due.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new transaction reference (an opaque id beginning with "ptx_"), the contract reference, the booked amount in US dollars with 2 decimals, the date the charge is dated with (YYYY-MM-DD) and the new fees due balance in US dollars with 2 decimals. The presence of the transaction reference shows the charge was booked.

### Dating, by example (hypothetical dates)

| Records | Transport charge |
|---|---|
| Repossessed on the 4th, most recent condition report dated the 9th | owed, dated the 9th |
| Repossessed on the 4th, most recent condition report dated the 4th | owed, dated the 4th |
| Repossessed on the 4th, only condition report dated before the 4th | not yet owed |
| Voluntary surrender | none |
